direction: D1 The 2024 naming break: content, people, or tool?
outcome_primary: name_primary (NAME: coined lead before colon/spaced dash)

H1a.statement: Dated 2024 slope break in a segmented logit on U; holds in NA pool and non-LLM subset; sup-LR selects 2024/2025; placebo breaks 2020-22 null

H1b.statement: Content's share of the 2023->2026 rise in [0.20, 0.50] for every name-masked representation; none >= 0.60

H1c.statement: Acceleration of content-unexplained drift: mean(u_2024-26) - mean(u_2019-23) > 0, ratio >= 1.5

established_topics_only.note: u_y averaged over papers outside topic100 clusters whose share grew >= 3x vs the training window (exploratory split of the pre-registered new-topic placebo)

H1d.statement: DFL reweighting of 2024-26 to 2023 composition (size x newcomer x llm_topic) explains <= 30%

H1e.statement: Tool bounded: F=0 rise >= 85% of total; delta <= +5pp; max tool share at A_max < 0.25

tool.F_definition: F_d1 = f24_2 (>= 2 distinct RARE21 words in abstract) | f26 | title_typo
tool.A_note: A_max = 0.39 is the PLAN's held-out greedy abstract bound for 2026 (taken as given; not re-estimated in D1); sensitivity range 0.24-1.0

deviations_from_plan: Pilot ITS 1.28/yr was for colon (compound) titles; NAME estimated as pre-registered (all 4 definitions reported)
Added kink-only sup-LR scan as robustness next to the pre-specified level+slope scan
H1c paper bootstrap implemented as conditional (B=2000) and refit (B=300) versions; verdict uses the more conservative CI; added year-label permutation and Welch tests
C grids for R2 (keywords) and R6/R6b (one-hot) widened after the first fit hit the lower grid edge
Cross-fitted intercept recalibration also applied in fixed (to 2023) and placebo (to 2020) windows
R2 treats each normalised keyword phrase as one token
R5 removes the 6 frozen move n-grams by token-subsequence match
DFL newcomer bin (.5,1) read as (.5,1]; 4 rows without keys dropped
F for D1 = f24_2 | f26 | title_typo (the >=2 RARE21 variant per D3 note); A_max=0.39 taken from PLAN
R3 covers 2018-26 only (2019 rolling window trains on 2018)
Exploratory diagnostics added: R1u, R1n, R1@0.5, established-topics split of u, 3-year cumulative comparison
Extra script d1_summary.py for merging, Holm and figures
